about_the_game:
Join Marcel on his journey toward the Waterfall.

Guided by Master Pepper, dash from place to place as you try to find your way. Overcome challenges alongside Marcel and immerse yourself in a unique story.

In fallsaga:

  • Meet quirky and memorable characters.

  • Make important choices that shape the story.

  • Solve puzzles that occasionally block your path.

  • Defeat the enemies that stand in your way. (Or don’t. It’s up to you.)

  • Experience a nostalgic journey through pixel art visuals and chiptune music.

  • Witness a powerful and emotional narrative.

  • Watch out for the one-eyebrowed cat.

TRY OUT THE FIRST TWO CHAPTERS IN THE DEMO!

Each chapter of fallsaga brings Marcel into a new world with its own theme and mystery.

  • Chapter 1: "Everywhere is Blue"

  • Chapter 2: "The TV Studio"

  • ...

GAMEPLAY

Fallsaga is a narrative-driven game built around dialogues and story. Interacting with characters is the core mechanic. Your choices in conversations will influence how the story unfolds — and even alter the outcomes of smaller events. Sometimes, a single choice may determine someone’s fate. Marcel’s relationships with other characters are shaped by your decisions.

Enjoy puzzles that range from simple to thought-provoking. And puzzles aren’t the only thing blocking Marcel’s path — confront the people trying to stop him, and shape their fate as well.

WHO IS FALLSAGA FOR?

If you enjoy games that focus on storytelling and dialogue — where your choices shape the direction of the narrative — then fallsaga is just right for you!

If you like mysterious moments that make you wonder what's really happening behind the scenes, fallsaga will keep you intrigued throughout.

While experiencing the story, you'll also get to enjoy the atmosphere through occasional puzzles and action sequences that keep things engaging and prevent monotony.
